subject: Mid-cycle comp rebalance: exceptions for bonus, merit, and equity
messages:
From: Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Mar 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Mid-cycle comp rebalance: exceptions for bonus, merit, and equity

Team —

Following the org adjustments on the APAC product squad and two rapid promotions in Engineering, I need approvals for three one-off comp exceptions so we don’t lose top performers. I’ve attached a short memo and the updated comp matrix. Summary: 

1) Priya N. (Sr PM, Product) — one-time retention bonus $12,000. High-impact delivery on the integrations sprint; competing offer surfaced.
2) Rishi M. (Staff ML Eng) — equity refresh 0.03% (exception to refresh cadence) to bridge long-term comp gap after recent grade re-eval.
3) Mateo A. (Eng Manager) — merit increase + title uplift effective Apr 1; salary adjustment requires headcount/comp exception due to quarterly budget cap.

Asking for:
- Quick thumbs-up for the bonus and equity refresh so People Ops can prepare docs.
- Budget confirmation for Mateo’s salary uplift (total run-rate delta $28k/year).

Attachments: comp_exception_form_ava_team.pdf, comp_matrix_2026Q1.xlsx, manager_memo_midcycle.docx

If we can get approvals by EOD tomorrow I’ll route final paperwork to Rebecca at TalentPay for equity onboarding and DocuSign.

Thanks,
Ava Chen
Engineering Manager, Product Integrations
Redwood Inference
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>
To: Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Mar 2026 09:48:12 -0700
Subject: Re: Mid-cycle comp rebalance: exceptions for bonus, merit, and equity

Thanks Ava — quick clarifying Qs before I greenlight: 
- Total one‑time and recurring impact across the three folks (one-time payouts + annual run-rate).
- Which budget line should absorb Mateo’s +$28k run-rate? Is there reallocation in Q2 hiring freeze or an org underspend?
- Any precedent in the last 12 months for equity refreshes at that level for Staff/EMs?

Please paste the numbers inline if you can; saves a round trip.

—Dylan
Dylan Brooks
Head of Total Rewards
Redwood Inference
From: Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Mar 2026 10:05:33 -0700
Subject: Re: Mid-cycle comp rebalance: exceptions for bonus, merit, and equity

On Thu, Mar 12, 2026 at 9:48 AM Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com> wrote:
> Thanks Ava — quick clarifying Qs before I greenlight: 
> - Total one‑time and recurring impact across the three folks (one-time payouts + annual run-rate).
> - Which budget line should absorb Mateo’s +$28k run-rate? Is there reallocation in Q2 hiring freeze or an org underspend?
> - Any precedent in the last 12 months for equity refreshes at that level for Staff/EMs?

Numbers below (pulled from comp_matrix_2026Q1.xlsx):
- Priya N.: one-time retention bonus = $12,000 (one-time)
- Rishi M.: equity refresh = non-cash (estimated dilution-equivalent ~$18k/year) — treated as exception; no immediate cash impact
- Mateo A.: merit + salary change = $28,000 annual run-rate increase (ongoing)

Total one-time cash (this tranche): $12,000. Total recurring run-rate delta: $28,000 (+ estimated equity equivalent ~ $18k not on payroll).

Budget source: I propose shifting two unfilled headcount postings from Product (Q2 hiring hold) into this pool (estimated savings ~ $35k run-rate for remainder of year). I’ve attached a short headcount reallocation note in manager_memo_midcycle.docx.

Precedent: small number of equity refresh exceptions granted last year for L4->Staff transitions; Dylan can confirm exact approvals but the level here aligns with those past exceptions.

If that works, can we get a conditional approval so Neha/People Ops can draft the forms and Rebecca at TalentPay can prepare equity onboarding?

Thanks,
Ava
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Mar 2026 11:21:45 -0700
Subject: Re: Mid-cycle comp rebalance: exceptions for bonus, merit, and equity

Ava — thanks for the writeup and the matrix. People Ops supports the proposed bonus and the equity refresh in principle. Two requests before we route for signature: 
1) Please confirm manager calibration notes (one-paragraph per person) for the HR file — quick bullets on impact, comparable market data, and retention risk.
2) Loop Rebecca Ng (TalentPay) for the equity grant paperwork and tax forms; cc: rebecca.ng@talentpay.com when you route the packet.

I will hold off on final payroll processing until Laura confirms budget absorption for Mateo’s run-rate increase.

—Neha
Neha Kapoor
Senior People Partner, Redwood Inference
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Mar 2026 13:02:07 -0700
Subject: Re: Mid-cycle comp rebalance: exceptions for bonus, merit, and equity

Adding quick support notes for the record (cc above):
- Priya delivered three critical integrations ahead of schedule; customer NPS uplift documented in the attached matrix. Losing her now would risk multiple pipeline accounts.
- Rishi led the model migration that reduced inference costs 12% — retention at his level is critical for roadmap Q3.
- Mateo has been backfilling two ICs and carrying manager-of-manager responsibilities informally; promotion is in-flight and this adjustment prevents backfilling risk.

Happy to provide short manager calibration bullets to Neha; I’ll draft and send in the next hour.

—Marcus
Marcus Lin
Director, Engineering
Redwood Inference
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 13 Mar 2026 14:37:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Mid-cycle comp rebalance: exceptions for bonus, merit, and equity

Thanks everyone — I’ve reviewed the numbers and the headcount reallocation rationale. Finance will approve Mateo’s run-rate increase on the condition that:
1) The underspend from two frozen Product postings is formally reallocated to Ava’s team and tracked in the Q2 hiring report.
2) We limit discretionary hiring in Product by 2 FTEs for the remainder of Q2 to offset the uplift.

Conditional approvals:
- Priya retention bonus: APPROVED (one-time payment).
- Rishi equity refresh: APPROVED pending standard exec sign-off; route docs to rebecca.ng@talentpay.com for grant paperwork.
- Mateo merit + title: APPROVED conditional on the two finance items above.

Neha/Dylan — please prepare a DocuSign packet (I’ll sign) and loop TalentPay for the equity onboarding. Ava — after you add the manager bullets, cc: rebecca.ng@talentpay.com and I’ll complete the sign-off.

Laura Bennett
VP, Finance & Operations
Redwood Inference
